criteria.label: Rainfall suitability
criteria.statement: Rabi rainfall in Salem was 545 mm against a normal of 342 mm (+59.5% from normal). TNAU guide for this crop: "Rainfall mm 600 - 800".

sources.dataset: IMD district rainfall (TN Season & Crop Report 2024-25)

criteria.label: Soil suitability
criteria.statement: District Soil Health Card fertility index 31/100 (N Low, P Medium, K High dominant classes). Soil Health Card 2024-25, Salem: pH: 93.33% of 14,955 tested samples are 'Neutral' (13,958); Organic carbon: 99.39% of 14,965 tested samples are 'Low' (14,874); Nitrogen (available N): 99.6% of 14,982 tested samples are 'Low' (14,922); Phosphorus (available P): 44.25% of 14,984 tested samples are 'Medium' (6,631); Potassium (available K): 57.82% of 14,986 tested samples are 'High' (8,665); Electrical conductivity: 97.83% of 14,963 tested samples are 'NonSaline' (14,638); most frequently deficient micronutrient: Sulphur (70.27% of samples). Soil type and numeric values are official data unavailable. The crop's soil and pH requirement: Official data unavailable.

soil_master.dataset: Soil Health Card portal, district nutrient dashboard

criteria.label: Water availability
criteria.statement: Officially 2% of this crop's area in Salem is irrigated; reservoir storage averaged 87% of capacity (irrigation risk 0.12); TNAU guide: "Irrigate immediately after sowing, followed by life irrigation on third day. Irrigate at interval of 7 to 10 days depending upon soil and climatic conditions. Flowering and pod formation stages are critical periods when irrigation is a must.".

sources.dataset: TN Season & Crop Report 2024-25 - irrigated/unirrigated area

criteria.label: Budget suitability
criteria.statement: CACP cost of production Rs 5,788/quintal x 6.3 quintals expected = Rs 36,464 (51% of the plan's Rs 71,996). No budget limit was set for this plan.

sources.dataset: PIB Minimum Support Price notification with CACP cost of production (A2+FL)
TN Season & Crop Report 2024-25 - district crop area, production, yield

criteria.label: Fertiliser requirement
criteria.statement: TNAU recommends N 12.5 : P2O5 25 : K2O 12.5 kg/ha (TNAU 'rainfed' (irrigated share 2%)); this plan applies 0.70 x that dose = 9 : 18 : 9 kg/ha.

criteria.label: Market price
criteria.statement: Official data unavailable: no official market (mandi) price dataset is loaded, so no current market price is stated. The official price floor (MSP) is given separately.

criteria.label: Minimum Support Price (MSP)
criteria.statement: Notified MSP Rs 8,682/quintal against CACP cost of production Rs 5,788/quintal (+50% margin, computed from these two official figures).

criteria.label: Expected yield
criteria.statement: Official Salem yield 0.25 t/ha; after the rainfall/water/soil reliability check the plan expects 0.13 t/ha (48% lower). TNAU guide reference: "Grain yield (kg/ha) Rainfed (kg/ha) 980 - 750 775 500 (rice fallow) 936 Irrigated (kg/ha) - 845 900 880 - 1251".
